# sonatypeiq_config_jira (Resource)

Manage Jira integration configuration for IQ Server

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create and manage Jira integration configuration for Sonatype IQ Server
resource "sonatypeiq_config_jira" "jira_config" {
  url      = "https://jira.my-domain.tld"
  username = "iq-integration"
  password = var.jira_password

  # Optional: custom fields for Jira integration
  # custom_fields = jsonencode({
  #   field1 = {
  #     key1 = "value1"
  #   }
  # })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) URL of the Jira server

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (String) Custom fields for Jira integration as JSON string
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Jira authentication
- `username` (String) Username for Jira authentication

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID for Terraform State
- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Jira Configuration can be imported.

# Example
terraform import sonatypeiq_config_jira.config system-jira-configuration
```
